label: Research & News
description: Academic search, community aggregators, encyclopedias and news feeds — almost all keyless.

nodes.label: arXiv: Search Papers
nodes.description: Search arXiv preprints via the export Atom API (keyless). Response body is Atom XML.
nodes.search: arxiv papers preprint research physics math cs ml academic search science

config.label: Search query
config.help: arXiv query syntax, e.g. all:electron, ti:"large language models", cat:cs.CL

nodes.label: Hacker News: Search
nodes.description: Full-text search over Hacker News stories and comments via the Algolia API (keyless).
nodes.search: hacker news hn search stories comments tech algolia startup discussion

config.label: Filter tags
config.help: Restrict results to one item type

nodes.label: Hacker News: Top Stories
nodes.description: Fetch the current top story IDs from the official HN Firebase API (keyless). Body is a JSON array of item IDs; fetch details per item at /v0/item/{id}.json.
nodes.search: hacker news hn top stories front page trending firebase ids poll

nodes.label: Reddit: Hot Posts
nodes.description: Fetch the hot posts of a subreddit via the public JSON listing (keyless).
nodes.search: reddit subreddit hot posts trending listing community feed poll

nodes.label: Reddit: Top Posts
nodes.description: Fetch the top posts of a subreddit for a timeframe via the public JSON listing (keyless).
nodes.search: reddit subreddit top posts best day week month listing community

nodes.label: Reddit: Search
nodes.description: Search Reddit posts sitewide via the public JSON search endpoint (keyless).
nodes.search: reddit search posts query community discussion opinions find

nodes.label: Wikipedia: Page Summary
nodes.description: Fetch the lead summary of an English Wikipedia page via the REST API (keyless).
nodes.search: wikipedia summary article page encyclopedia definition extract lookup

config.label: Page title
config.help: Exact page title; use underscores instead of spaces

nodes.label: Wikipedia: Search Pages
nodes.description: Search English Wikipedia page titles and content via the MediaWiki REST search API (keyless).
nodes.search: wikipedia search pages articles encyclopedia find topic lookup

nodes.label: PubMed: Search (ESearch)
nodes.description: Search PubMed for article IDs via the NCBI E-utilities esearch endpoint (keyless).
nodes.search: pubmed medical papers biomedical ncbi esearch clinical research health articles

config.label: Search term
config.help: PubMed query syntax, e.g. asthma[mesh] AND 2024[pdat]

nodes.label: PubMed: Get Summaries (ESummary)
nodes.description: Fetch article metadata for PubMed IDs via the NCBI E-utilities esummary endpoint (keyless). Pair with PubMed Search.
nodes.search: pubmed summaries metadata esummary articles details authors journal ncbi

config.label: PubMed IDs
config.help: Comma-separated PMIDs (e.g. from pubmed.search ids output)

nodes.label: Semantic Scholar: Search Papers
nodes.description: Search academic papers via the Semantic Scholar Graph API (keyless, rate-limited).
nodes.search: semantic scholar papers academic citations research literature search science

nodes.label: Crossref: Search Works
nodes.description: Search scholarly works (DOIs, journals, books) via the Crossref REST API (keyless).
nodes.search: crossref doi papers journals scholarly works citations metadata search academic

config.label: Contact email
config.help: Optional; joins the Crossref polite pool for better service

nodes.label: Stack Exchange: Search Questions
nodes.description: Search questions on a Stack Exchange site (e.g. Stack Overflow) via the public API (keyless).
nodes.search: stackoverflow stack exchange questions answers programming error debug search

config.label: Site
config.help: API site parameter, e.g. stackoverflow, serverfault, superuser

nodes.label: OpenAlex: Search Works
nodes.description: Search the open catalog of scholarly works via the OpenAlex API (keyless).
nodes.search: openalex scholarly works papers open access citations research search academic

nodes.label: NewsAPI: Top Headlines
nodes.description: Fetch breaking news headlines by country, category or keyword via NewsAPI.org (API key required).
nodes.search: news headlines breaking articles media press country category newsapi current

config.label: Country
config.help: 2-letter ISO code; leave empty when using only q

config.label: Keyword
config.help: At least one of country, category or keyword must be set

nodes.label: GDELT: Search News Documents
nodes.description: Search worldwide news coverage via the GDELT DOC 2.0 API (keyless).
nodes.search: gdelt news global coverage monitoring articles world events media search

config.label: Query
config.help: GDELT query syntax; supports sourcelang:, domain:, sourcecountry: operators

config.label: Timespan
config.help: How far back to search, e.g. 1h, 24h, 7d, 3m

nodes.label: Lobsters: Hottest Stories
nodes.description: Fetch the current hottest stories from Lobste.rs via its public JSON feed (keyless). Body is a JSON array of stories.
nodes.search: lobsters hottest stories tech aggregator programming links trending feed
